harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured NFS export of /srv/nfs/shared on node1 mounted at /mnt/shared on node2, using a shared dataops (UID/GID 4500) identity on both nodes and directory ownership dataops:dataops with mode 2770. Verified cross-node write consistency, then restarted node1 and node2 sequentially, confirming changed boot IDs and full recovery of the NFS export/mount and correct ownership/permissions afterward.
actions_performed: Inspected both nodes' initial state (Ubuntu 24.04, no dataops user, no NFS packages)
Created dataops user/group with UID/GID 4500 on node1 and node2
Installed nfs-kernel-server on node1 and nfs-common on node2
Created /srv/nfs/shared on node1, set owner dataops:dataops and mode 2770
Configured /etc/exports on node1 restricting to node2's IP with rw,sync,no_subtree_check, ran exportfs -ra
Enabled and started nfs-kernel-server on node1, verified port 2049 listening
Created /mnt/shared on node2, verified export visibility via showmount, added fstab entry, mounted the NFS4 share
Verified cross-node file creation as dataops preserves UID/GID 4500 ownership on both nodes; cleaned up test files
Captured pre-restart boot_id and service/export/mount health baseline on both nodes
Restarted node1 via reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id, verified nfs-kernel-server active, export intact, and node2's mount still functional with correct ownership
Restarted node2 via reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id, verified fstab auto-remounted the share and file creation as dataops still yields correct ownership
Cleaned up all test files, left /srv/nfs/shared in final state dataops:dataops mode 2770

evidence.requirement: dataops identity UID/GID 4500 created on both nodes
evidence.summary: id dataops shows uid=4500(dataops) gid=4500(dataops) on node1 and node2

evidence.requirement: NFS server exports /srv/nfs/shared from node1 with dataops:dataops 2770
evidence.summary: nfs-kernel-server installed, /srv/nfs/shared created with mode 2770 owned by dataops:dataops, /etc/exports configured and exportfs -v confirms export to node2, service active and listening on 2049
nfs-common installed, showmount confirms export visibility, fstab entry added and mount succeeded showing nfs4 mount at /mnt/shared
Files created as dataops from node2 and node1 both show uid/gid dataops:dataops on both nodes; directory mode confirmed 2770 after cleanup

evidence.requirement: node1 restart evidence: baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id a0c36ad2...; reboot triggered and acknowledged; connection reset confirms disruption; new boot_id 30a820d8... proves restart; nfs-kernel-server active with export intact post-restart; node2 mount continued functioning with correct dataops ownership after node1 restart

evidence.requirement: node2 restart evidence: baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id e8afb731...; reboot triggered and acknowledged; connection reset confirms disruption; new boot_id a3dc379d... proves restart; post-restart mount auto-recovered via fstab and file creation as dataops shows correct ownership

evidence.requirement: Final clean state of shared directory
evidence.summary: Final state of /srv/nfs/shared confirmed dataops:dataops ownership and mode 2770, test files removed
